**Key eliminations:**
- Trichoderma: green mold (no)

- **Diplodia_Ear_Rot**: Shows white mycelium but the cross-section had black pycnidia and kernels were more shrunken/brown.
- **Fusarium_Disease**: Scattered white mycelium on otherwise normal kernels — less uniform than what the test image shows.

The Gibberella_Disease reference (Corn_Disease_42.jpg) is the closest visual match: white cottony mycelium blanketing plump golden kernels, with pinkish discoloration — exactly what the test image shows.
